answer.rationale: The immediate competitive pressure on price creates urgency, but exp_73 definitively shows targeted discounting destroys cohort quality and retention. Repeating that mistake would worsen the problem. Instead, deploy simplify_onboarding (memory_86, memory_31) to accelerate time-to-value and deepen account stickiness among at-risk SMB customers—addressing retention risk without margin erosion. This strategy is proven on SMB activation and compounds with activation_messaging (memory_91) in follow-up. Referral incentives (memory_57) can amplify the effect among retained customers. Enterprise_sales_assist (memory_44) is orthogonal to the SMB churn pressure. A standard_experiment scope allows rapid measurement of whether simplified flows reduce churn velocity while preserving pricing integrity. This preserves long-term unit economics against the existential risk of the acquisition trap.
